title: Verify: shutdown removes focus unit tests
summary: Phaser-mocked test that SHUTDOWN blurs objects and nulls the store focus
description: Run create with fake objects, trigger the captured shutdown handler, assert cleanup.
acceptance_criteria: Blur is called on every object

steps.action: Copy the mock setup from bootSceneKeyboard.test.ts with two fakes having blur: vi.fn(), focus: vi.fn(), isFocused false. Set useGameStore.setState({ focusedObjectId: 'bed' }), call boot.create(), take the 'shutdown' callback from events.once.mock.calls and invoke it. Assert each fake blur was called, useGameStore.getState().focusedObjectId is null, then clear mocks, call setState({ focusedObjectId: 'bed' }) and assert focus was not called again.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneFocusShutdown.test.ts
